text:
alex: Starting a relnotes + changelog draft for the upcoming docs deploy. Scope: release bullets, known-issues, migration blurbs (Dedicated routing), and SDK snippet parity. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4899

maria: I'll run a linkcheck across /docs and the legacy redirects file. Please flag any anchor renames; I saw a few in the quantization section earlier.

sam: Heads-up: JS + Python SDK examples diverged. Some pages still use `Client.create(...)` while new API is `await client.responses.create(...)`. We should standardize before localization.

jordan: Found one stale link in /docs/guides/migrate-0.9-to-0.10 -> points to `old-routing` which was renamed. I'll open a tiny redirect PR and update the link.

alex: Good. Also want a short Known Issue entry about embeddings streaming regression on long inputs. Lina, can you provide repro and suggested workaround?

lina: Yep. Repro: feed >7000 tokens when combining chunking + streaming, CI harness sometimes returns 403s. Workaround: set `batch_size: 1` and enable `prefix_cache` in the embeddings client; we documented the tweak in INT-527. I'll paste snippet after.

sam: Draft JS snippet for relnotes (aligned with new client):
```javascript
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const res = await client.responses.create({
  model: 'redwood-kestrel-1',
  input: 'Summarize the docs updates',
});
console.log(res.output_text);
```

maria: Use single-quotes for consistency? Our style guide prefers double quotes in docs examples. Also add `try/catch` around calls in the examples where we show error handling.

jordan: I'll include the redirect PR link in the relnotes so readers see the fix. Also adding a line in the Dedicated guide: routing policy v2 changes fallback ordering; customers who pin models should double-check rollout config.

docs-bot: docs-ci started build #590 for PR #4899 -- status: running

alex: Cutoff for copy + localization: 2024-09-29 EOD. Release publish target: 2024-10-03 17:00 PT. Please stagger merges so translators get the final strings.

sam: I'll batch the snippet parity fixes + one-line changelog bullets into PR #4899 to minimize churn. Planning to list exact files touched in the PR description.

maria: Quick note: intl team flagged a problem with fr/zh snippets where placeholders weren't normalized. I filed INTL-738 and added a checklist item in the PR template.

lina: Pasted the embeddings troubleshooting snippet in the PR comment and linked EVAL-2024-09-02 for the internal test results.

jordan: PR #4902 opened for the redirect + Dedicated blurb link from the Dedicated page to the changelog. CI green.

docs-bot: PR #4899 build succeeded; torchlink check passed

alex: Thanks team. Sam, add the final Known Issues + migration blurb into the relnotes PR and I will proof. After that we can cut the release branch. :rocket:
